topics.title: Introduction, Colour Theory, Techniques, Types, and Functions of Painting

subtopics.content: Pictorial vs decorative painting, tools and equipment, elements/principles of design, colour classes/properties/schemes, local colour improvisation, pictorial techniques (dry, wet, glazing, impasto, fresco, tempera), decorative techniques (flat, rag rolling, scumbling, spraying, mural, mosaic), body and wall decoration motifs and materials
subtopics.objective: Distinguish pictorial from decorative painting and select appropriate tools[cite: 517]; apply elements/principles of design[cite: 518]; master colour classes, properties, schemes, and local colour sourcing[cite: 518]; execute pictorial techniques (impasto, fresco, glazing) and decorative techniques (scumbling, rag rolling, mural, mosaic)[cite: 518]; analyze still life, nature, and life compositions[cite: 518]; compare traditional and modern body/wall decorations, motifs, and materials[cite: 518, 519].

topics.title: Perspective, Career Prospects, Costing, Marketing, and Practical Decorative Execution

subtopics.content: Perspective principles and types, socio-economic values, career pathways, job costing factors, exhibition planning/funding, pricing, sales outlets, and practical execution of decorative renderings using poster or acrylic colors
subtopics.objective: Apply perspective types to enhance depth in pictorial compositions[cite: 519]; explore socio-economic opportunities and career pathways in decorative arts[cite: 519]; cost projects based on location, size, materials, and time[cite: 519]; plan exhibitions, negotiate, market, and sell artworks[cite: 519]; execute aesthetic environment designs practically in poster/acrylic media[cite: 519].
